sloka: सीत कपीन्द्र क्षणदा चराणाम्राजीव हेम ज्वलनोपमानानि ।सुग्रीव राम प्रणय पसङ्गेवामानि नेत्राणि समम् स्फुरन्ति ॥४-५-३१॥
transliteration: sīta kapīndra kṣaṇadā carāṇāmrājīva hema jvalanopamānāni ।sugrīva rāma praṇaya pasaṅgevāmāni netrāṇi samam sphuranti ॥4-5-31॥

translations.english: 'O Rama, by your grace I will get my wife and kingdom back. O king accomplish this so that I can destroy my, elder brother, my enemy, O lion among men
